text:
diego_sales: Prospect (EU payroll vendor) emailed RFP asking for proof that POC traffic will stay in EU. they want artifacts: flow diagram, netflow export, and KMS region audit. they don't want to buy Dedicated yet. can we deliver?
meera_se: TL;DR: yes for a timeboxed POC with caveats. Hosted supports tenant affinity; for absolute cryptographic residency you need Dedicated/Private with BYOK. we can produce logs and run a scoped policy for 10 days.
vik_ops: Ops can enable a temporary routing policy that pins the tenant to eu-west-1 and disables cross-region fallback for the POC window. we'll enable netflow capture and a KMS-region audit mode, then hand over CSV exports. this is manual and requires an ops ticket + on-call review.
diego_sales: can we offer a temporary "EU KMS escrow" for the POC so customer sees keys never left EU?
sophia_compliance: short: we can route secrets to a regional cloud KMS instance and record KMS region audit logs, but Hosted uses our managed key service (multi-region) by default. for POC we can create a scoped regional key policy and produce audit evidence but not a contract-level guarantee. any stronger guarantee needs BYOK in Dedicated/Private.
meera_se: sample header for region hint to show the RFP:```
POST /v1/complete
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}
x-tenant-id: payroll-prospect
x-region-hint: eu-central-1
```
This will steer requests to EU capacity.
vik_ops: deliverables we can provide for the RFP: 1) flow diagram of processing path, 2) netflow export for the POC tenant, 3) KMS region audit CSV for the scoped key, 4) sub-processor list with EU-only vendors highlighted. note: vendor dashboards may have multi-region control planes; we will provide exported artifacts.
diego_sales: procurement will ask about cost/time to move to Dedicated if they want strict legal guarantees.
meera_se: ballpark: converting to Dedicated is typically 2-4x the hosted unit cost depending on commit and model family; provisioning lead time 4-6 weeks. we can propose a short-term regional reservation as a middle ground (monthly minimum).
sophia_compliance: suggested RFP wording: "Redwood can implement tenant-scoped regional affinity and provide timeboxed operational evidence (netflow, KMS audit logs, processing path diagram). For contractual in-region-only guarantees, Redwood offers Dedicated or Private deployments with customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM)."
vik_ops: created ticket RD-POC-777 to enable scoped routing and logging, owners @vik_ops and @meera_se, target start in 4 business days. ops-bot: ticket created.
diego_sales: perfect. i'll attach this thread and request the customer's questionnaire. once they send it we'll drop it here and Sophia can review the RFP text. :thumbsup:
